# Subway Seat for broot

The tree in the eza port's colors: gold directories, avocado executables, sage links, the same permission and git colors, and file sizes and disk use along the avocado-to-redbird stripe. Panels you aren't in go quieter, the status line sits on the darker chrome, and previews of diffs use the shared tinted grounds. broot can only highlight previews with syntect's built-in themes, so the skins pick the closest: Mocha for the dark flavors, Solarized Light for Enamel. broot picks the import that matches your terminal's background, so the auto pair follows light and dark.

[broot](https://dystroy.org/broot/) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/broot/) · Needs broot 1.14+

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only broot
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in the imports list in ~/.config/broot/conf.hjson (replace the skin entry for your terminal):

```json
{ "luma": ["dark", "light", "unknown"], "file": "skins/subway-seat.hjson" }
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in the imports list in ~/.config/broot/conf.hjson (replace the skin entry for your terminal):

```json
{ "luma": ["dark", "light", "unknown"], "file": "skins/subway-seat-tunnel.hjson" }
```

## Follow light and dark

In the imports list in ~/.config/broot/conf.hjson, instead of the default skin entries:

```json
{ "luma": ["dark", "unknown"], "file": "skins/subway-seat.hjson" }
{ "luma": "light", "file": "skins/subway-seat-enamel.hjson" }
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/broot/skins/subway-seat.hjson`.
- Delete `~/.config/broot/skins/subway-seat-tunnel.hjson`.
- Delete `~/.config/broot/skins/subway-seat-enamel.hjson`.
- Delete `~/.config/broot/skins/london-moquette.hjson`.
- Delete `~/.config/broot/skins/london-deep-level.hjson`.
- Delete `~/.config/broot/skins/london-portland.hjson`.
- Delete `~/.config/broot/skins/paris-guimard.hjson`.
- Delete `~/.config/broot/skins/paris-catacombes.hjson`.
- Delete `~/.config/broot/skins/paris-carrelage.hjson`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
